sources.author: GinArena
patch_list: Shows the browser accessibility and shortcut-menu-strip setup prompts once, then records each as shown as soon as it appears so closing the browser before dismissing it cannot make it repeat.

Sets fresh-install browser fallbacks for normal and incognito modes: Brave search, matching suggestions, and Google search by image by default. Saved or imported choices are preserved and can be changed later in 1DM.

Removes visible banner/full-screen ads and 1DM+ promotions from free 1DM 20.0 (30257), including the downloads-home VPN promo bar and sponsored browser start-page tiles. User shortcuts remain available.
